title: Position-free KV transfer after inverse RoPE
hypothesis: For the frozen Pythia-70M→SmolLM2-135M pair, fitting affine maps after inverse source/target RoPE and reapplying target RoPE improves long-context heldout next-token NLL over direct RoPE-space ridge; a rank≤32 shared map basis retains the position-free full-map quality within 0.05 nat while reducing mapper bytes by at least 50%.
physical_object: One position-free cross-model translator family across target KV layer/head roles.
mirror_coordinate: Per-role coefficients into a shared PCA map basis; target RoPE is reapplied after map reconstruction.
logical_multiplicity: Layer/head-specific target cache translators from one shared translator basis.

development.selection_metric: Mean transferred next-token NLL delta vs full position-free independent ridge; ranks must also satisfy absolute target delta and actual-byte screen.

fresh.prompt_identity: exact tokenizer offset alignment; deterministic pair/seed disjoint chunks
fresh.test_context_positions: Report all prompt lengths and separately summarize prompts whose tested prefix extends beyond position 64.

map_fit: Per target layer/KV head and K/V role closed-form affine ridge, alpha=0.01. Calibration fit sees only positions 0..63. Position-free path inverts each model RoPE for K, fits K and V in content coordinates, then reapplies target RoPE to translated K. Direct control fits/applies maps in each model’s stored RoPE space.

paid_objects: affine map or shared mean+basis+per-role coefficients
storage.common_model_weights: reported separately; not part of marginal translator comparison

compute.hardware: CPU only; source prefill, target prefill, calibration, map fit, translation, suffix timing separated

success_gate: On fresh seeds, position-free independent maps improve mean NLL over direct RoPE-space ridge by >=0.10 nat on each seed; rank32 is within +0.05 nat of position-free full maps on every seed; actual shared mapper bytes <=50% of independent maps; the 3-seed mean compressed delta vs native target prefill <=0.50 nat.
failure_gate: Any required quality or storage gate fails in at least two of three fresh seeds, or exact inverse/reapply validation fails.
boundaries: One ordered model pair only; no general cross-family claim.
Only one next-token target per prompt and Wikitext-2.
Single tokenization offset-aligned prompt source; no long-generation trajectory claim.
CPU latency only; no GPU or serving adoption claim.
A native shared PCA map code is the attribution control; matching it means no Mirror-specific gain.
